subject: person yawning
title: Most People Yawn Just Watching Others Yawn. Scientists Can't Say Why

scenes.text: There's a good chance you yawn before this video ends.
At Duke University, 328 people watched a three-minute video of yawning. 68 percent yawned.
Some yawned once. Some yawned fifteen times.
And in one study, 21 of 29 dogs yawned after watching a stranger yawn, though later studies disagree.
The strange part: age was the only clear predictor, and it explained just eight percent of who yawned.
So if you yawned just now, you're in the majority. Did you?

description:
Yawning is contagious, and science still can't fully explain why.
In a 2014 Duke study, 222 of 328 people (68 percent) yawned at least once while watching a three-minute yawning video, from 0 to 15 times each. Age was the only significant predictor and explained only about 8 percent of the difference; empathy showed no strong link. A 2008 study found 21 of 29 dogs yawned when a human did, though later studies did not replicate it.
Did you yawn watching this?
